_comment: Synthetic fixture config for XSPEC-383 R7-c — the UNREADABLE-LIST demonstration.
Same family as the green config, but ownedDomains points at a file that is not there.
The failure mode this pins: treating 'could not read the owned-domain list' as
'the list is empty, so every domain is allowed' — which turns the strictest
possible check into the most permissive one, silently.
Expected outcome: exit 2, never 0 and never 1.
